sections.name: Luncheon Menu (Prix Fixe)
items: Choose one soup or salad (Pasta e Fagioli, Tortellini in Brodo, Soup of the Day, or Insalata Mista), one entrée (Spaghetti and Meatballs, Cannelloni al Forno, Timballo, Rigatoni and Vodka Sauce, Pasta del Veliero, Chicken Parmigiana, Piccata or Marsala over ziti, or Tilapia Francese), plus coffee or tea. No substitutions; 20% gratuity added to parties of 5 or more.
